cases.source: introduced by 87c57037832f (fix(#103): recorded-pid identity check in probeRun — pid reuse and unrelated processes can); repaired by 07b251cbe7bc

expected.summary: probeRun/interpretLiveness: the probe emits `CMDLINE ` (empty marker) for a dead pid, but the line is trimmed before filtering with a needle that needs the trailing space, so the bare marker leaks into the process list and a dead recorded pid with no identity hint reports a live run (false-alive). Fixed in #265.

cases.source: introduced by 5d0537a4d737 (fix(#139): redact URL userinfo credentials with delimiters and bare/port-only hosts (#153)); repaired by 7ea25ca7b660
cases.diff:
diff --git a/src/untrusted.ts b/src/untrusted.ts
index 1111948..a12116f 100644
--- a/src/untrusted.ts
+++ b/src/untrusted.ts
@@ -19,10 +19,16 @@ const SECRET_PATTERNS: Array<[RegExp, string]> = [
   [/\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b/g, "[REDACTED:aws-key]"],
   [/\bxox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}\b/g, "[REDACTED:slack-token]"],
   // Credentials embedded in a URL: scheme://user:password@host
-  [/\b([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s:@\/]+:)[^\s@\/]+@/gi, "$1[REDACTED]@"],
+  // The password class (`[^\s]*?`, lazy) may contain `/`, `?`, `#` and `@`; the
+  // trailing lookahead anchors on a plausible host token -- dotted (`db.internal`),
+  // `host:port`, a bracketed `[IPv6]` literal, OR a bare single-label host
+  // terminated by `/`, `?`, `#` or end-of-string (`db/app`, `intranet/x`). A
+  // password with delimiters or an embedded `@` is therefore removed whole while
+  // the host stays readable; prose like `mail me@x.org` stays untouched.
+  [/\b([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s:@\/]+:)([^\s]*?)@(?=[A-Za-z0-9\[][^\s@\/]*(?:\.[^\s@\/]*|:[0-9]+)?(?:[\/?#]|$))/gi, "$1[REDACTED]@"],
   [/\b(Bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]{20,}=*/gi, "$1[REDACTED]"],
   [
-    /\b((?:api[_-]?key|secret|token|password|passwd|authorization)["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?)[^\s"',;]{8,}/gi,
+    /\b((?:api[_-]?key|access_token|secret|token|password|passwd|pwd|authorization)["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?)[^\s"',;]{8,}/gi,
     "$1[REDACTED]",
   ],
 ];

expected.summary: redactSecrets: URL userinfo redaction does not handle an empty username (`redis://:password@host`), so the password leaks unredacted. Fixed in #160.

cases.source: introduced by ca0e57c96017 (feat(#177,#178): review records and the sync review gate (#181)); repaired by c83ee0a22d4b

expected.summary: validateReview accepts a PASS when at least one command exited 0 even if another recorded command failed (it only checks `commands.some(exitCode === 0)`), so a failed verification can sit next to `echo ok` under an approval. Fixed in #184.

cases.source: introduced by 49494bdcfeb4 (fix(#105): capability probe — report per-node isolation levels and refuse un-honourable di); repaired by 0c3030ca98fc

expected.summary: The #105 isolation-capability probe targets `remoteIp ?? sshHost` while the cwd probe targets `loginUser@nodeKey`; with a login user set the two probes address different host strings, so the gate can mis-report or refuse a capable node. Fixed in #164.

cases.source: introduced by 6508b33b2f64 (feat(#63): fleet_cleanup prunes finished runs from the node state dir (state.prune op, pro); repaired by e01d7eb906ba

expected.summary: fleet_cleanup: a payload-less refusal from the node prune op is dropped instead of reported, so a refused prune reads as success. Fixed in #63.

cases.source: introduced by 7d00995418e5 (fix(#31 follow-up): refuse cwd equal to ANY allowed root; fleet_diff takes a real cwd); repaired by 8ac4bb642f76

expected.summary: guardCwd exempts `__DIFF__` from cwd confinement (it is in CWD_FREE_OPS), but `__DIFF__` runs `cd <cwd> && git diff`, so the allowlist and symlink checks are skipped for it. Fixed in #31 (the exemption is dropped).

cases.source: 07b251cbe7bc (fix(#265): the empty CMDLINE marker no longer counts as a process (false-alive for hint-le); a repair that review accepted
cases.scary: the fix touches the same trim/filter code a reviewer may distrust; it is correct (filters on the bare marker) and has a regression test

cases.source: 7ea25ca7b660 (fix(#160): redact empty-username URL credentials (redis://:***@host)); a repair that review accepted
cases.scary: a regex change in a redactor that pins a known, documented over-redaction as fail-safe: intentionally conservative, not a leak
